ALTER TABLE tz_authoring_job
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS staging_json jsonb NULL
    CHECK (staging_json IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(staging_json) = 'object');

ALTER TABLE tz_authoring_job
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tz_authoring_job_status_check,
    ADD CONSTRAINT tz_authoring_job_status_check
        CHECK (status IN ('PLANNED', 'GENERATING', 'VERIFYING', 'READY', 'STAGED', 'FAILED'));

ALTER TABLE tz_authoring_job
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tz_authoring_job_artifact_status_check,
    ADD CONSTRAINT tz_authoring_job_artifact_status_check
        CHECK ((status IN ('READY', 'STAGED') AND artifact_json IS NOT NULL)
            OR status NOT IN ('READY', 'STAGED'));

ALTER TABLE tz_authoring_job
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tz_authoring_job_staging_status_check,
    ADD CONSTRAINT tz_authoring_job_staging_status_check
        CHECK ((status = 'STAGED' AND staging_json IS NOT NULL)
            OR (status <> 'STAGED' AND staging_json IS NULL));
